icons.instructions: Use Lucide React for all icons. Keep icon sizes consistent (e.g., w-4 h-4 for buttons, w-5 h-5 for metric cards). Color them according to their context (emerald for positive, rose for negative, stone-400 for neutral, text-amber-400 for review stars).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. STRUCTURE: The app should be full height (h-screen). Layout: Top sticky Header. Below it, a row of 4 Stats Cards. Below that, flex-1 container split into Left Panel (List) and Right Panel (Detail). Use overflow-hidden on the main wrapper and overflow-y-auto on the internal list/detail content areas to ensure fixed panels.

2. TYPOGRAPHY: Do not use default Inter for headings if possible, use standard sans but style it with tracking-tight and font-semibold for a premium feel. Metric values should be very large (text-3xl font-semibold).
3. COMPONENT STYLING: Apply the specified styling classes from the components section. Panels should have a clean white background, soft borders, and very subtle shadow.

4. AI RESPONSE: The AI Response area in the right panel is a key feature. Make it stand out with the emerald tint (bg-emerald-50/50), add a Sparkles icon to the header, and ensure the textarea looks highly polished.
5. DATA-TESTID: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, review list items, dialog triggers) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.
6. BRANDING DIALOG: For the Branding settings live preview, use the 'branding_preview' image URL as a background layer to simulate the hotel website.

7. INTERFACES: Use Shadcn components for Tabs, Dropdowns, Dialogs, and Selects, but override their border/radius classes to match this premium 'Organic & Earthy' theme (e.g., rounded-xl for Dialogs, subtle borders).
8. EMPTY STATES: If no review is selected, show a beautiful, centered empty state in the right panel with a soft text color (text-stone-400) and an icon.
